zh.title: 岳云鹏·孙越伦敦专场｜相声巡演的本地制作与现场记忆
zh.summary: 围绕双人表演的舞台需求组织本地制作、技术及人物支持，以演出影像保留相声在伦敦现场的具体呈现。
zh.preview: 语言、节奏与双人默契构成相声的核心。舞台技术、节目安排与妆造支持需要服务表演本身，现场记录则为这次伦敦演出留下可继续使用的内容。
zh.role: Vivian Adventure 参与本地制作、舞台与技术对接、人员及节目衔接，并提供妆造配合与现场记录。
zh.context: 岳云鹏与孙越的伦敦相声专场，将以语言和双人互动为核心的表演带入海外现场。本地制作需要围绕演员与节目组织实际支持，让舞台呈现与演出要求对应。

narrativeSections.heading: 服务语言型表演的舞台
narrativeSections.text: 相声的叙事由演员之间以及演员与观众之间的交流推进。舞台与技术对接的意义，在于让制作工作回应这种表演形式，为节目提供相应的现场条件。

narrativeSections.heading: 把巡演要求转为本地工作
narrativeSections.text: 团队参与人员、节目与舞台技术之间的对接，并配合人物妆造。多项职责围绕同一演出展开，将演员准备和舞台执行所需的协作落实到伦敦现场。

narrativeSections.heading: 让演出拥有具体的海外记录
narrativeSections.text: 双人表演画面保留舞台关系，带巡演信息的全景说明活动背景。影像可用于艺人演出回顾和巡演介绍，使后续沟通能够引用真实的伦敦现场。

deliverables: 本地制作、舞台与技术对接
人员及节目衔接、妆造配合
双人表演与巡演舞台影像
outcomes: 本地制作支持与现场记录共同服务伦敦相声专场。
交付影像保留双人表演和巡演背景，可用于演出回顾及艺人演出经历介绍。

en.title: Yue Yunpeng & Sun Yue | Bringing Crosstalk to a London Stage
en.summary: Local production, technical liaison and styling support served the duo’s performance, with imagery preserving its specific London stage setting.
en.preview: Crosstalk relies on language, timing and the relationship between two performers. Practical stage support served that form, while documentation gave the London show a continuing visual record.
en.role: Vivian Adventure contributed to local production, stage and technical liaison, people and programme transitions, alongside styling support and event documentation.
en.context: Yue Yunpeng and Sun Yue’s London crosstalk show brought a performance built on language and dialogue to an overseas stage. The local assignment needed to translate the needs of the duo and programme into practical production support.

narrativeSections.heading: A stage in service of dialogue
narrativeSections.text: Crosstalk develops through exchanges between the performers and with their audience. Stage and technical liaison matter because the production must respond to that form, providing the conditions around the programme.

narrativeSections.heading: Touring requirements, local coordination
narrativeSections.text: The team contributed to liaison across people, programme and stage requirements, with styling support for the performers. Those responsibilities brought talent preparation and practical stage work together at the London event.

narrativeSections.heading: A specific record of the overseas show
narrativeSections.text: Duo imagery retains the on-stage relationship, while wider views with tour graphics locate the performance. The resulting material can support show recaps and tour introductions with a visual reference to the London appearance.

deliverables: Local production, stage and technical liaison
People, programme transitions and styling support
outcomes: Local production support and documentation served the London crosstalk show together.
The imagery records the duo and tour setting for performance recaps and artist introductions.
